name: 2 Person Far Infrared Sauna (GSE-2)
description:
Relax comfortably in your electric infrared sauna
With Good Health Sauna’s 2-person sauna, you will be transported into your own serene and relaxing personal retreat. Our design comfortably seats up to two people and includes a high-tech sound system in addition to therapeutic chromotherapy lighting. This electric infrared sauna contains nine GHS certified heaters, which emits the highest quality infrared heat. Made from quality controlled Forest Stewardship Certified Wood, your sauna experience will be elevated to the next level.
